title: Explicit data-dependent characterizations of the subdifferential of convex pointwise suprema and optimality conditions
summary: We establish explicit data-dependent and symmetric characterizations of the subdifferential of the supremum of convex functions, formulated directly in terms of the underlying data functions. In our approach, both active and non-active functions contribute equally through their subdifferentials, thereby avoiding the need for additional geometric constructions, such as the domain of the supremum, that arise in previous developments.
